heading.html: Where Ancient Healing & Modern Luxury Meet For Ultimate Rejuvenation

children.text: Step into a world of natural healing with the Hinoki Bath at King Spa. Crafted from aromatic Japanese cypress, or “Hinoki,” this traditional, sacred bath invites you to slow down, breathe deeply, and let go of deeply held stress. Known for its calming scent and centuries-old role in Japanese bathing rituals, the Hinoki Bath offers a unique fusion of wellness and tradition—right here in Virginia. Visit King Spa today and experience the tranquility of our outdoor Hinoki Bath hot tub.

heading.html: What is the Hinoki Bath at King Spa?

children.text: A Hinoki Bath is a traditional Japanese soaking bath crafted from Hinoki wood—a type of sacred Japanese cypress celebrated for its gentle aroma and healing properties. At King Spa, this cedarwood immersion offers a calming escape rooted in centuries-old wellness traditions.

children.cls: elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-55c1590a womens-body-scrub active elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default

children.text: Key features of the Hinoki Bath include:

children.html:
Hinoki Wood Construction

Naturally antibacterial and moisture-resistant, ideal for repeated spa use.

Soothing Water Jets

Gentle hydrotherapy jets help release muscle tension and stimulate circulation.

Heated Water

Maintained at a warm, consistent temperature to relax muscles and promote circulation.

Aromatic Experience

Releases a light, citrusy-wood scent when exposed to warm water.

Deep Soaking Design

Encourages full-body immersion for complete relaxation.

Cultural Significance

Historically used in Japanese temples, hot springs, and homes for purification and meditation.

children.html:
Spa Admission Required

Access is included with general spa entry—just bring your ID and prepare to unwind.

What to Bring

Bring your swimsuit and ID for entry. We’ll provide the towels, lockers, and relaxation.

Hydration Is Key

Be sure to drink plenty of water before and after your soak.

Spacious Layout

The open design allows guests to stretch out and unwind without crowding, even during peak hours.

Perfect Before or After Treatments

Enjoy the Hinoki Bath before a body scrub or after time in the sauna to maximize benefits.

Convenient Location

The Hinoki Bath is located on the second floor, next to the outdoor bade pool, making it easy to enjoy both hydrotherapy experiences.

Open Year-Round

Heated and ready daily—ideal no matter the season.

children.html:
Vanessa Phillips

I can't recommend this place highly enough. My mom and I live fairly far apart but wanted a chill spa weekend together. It was phenomenal to meet up at Dulles, rent a car, and come to king spa! We really enjoyed the scrubs we got (would call a must experience if it's your first time), outdoor pool, and the environment in general. We were lucky enough to come when they have the spring promotion that if you buy entry + a service, another non-weekend entry is free.
Amanda The Traveler

Amazing Korean Spa with everything you may need! My husband and I went here to get away for a little while and I couldn't be happier with my experience! We were there for 6 hours, visited all of there many Sauna's, steam, ice, and relaxing rooms. And you can not forget there hot and warm pools! And when all is said and done you must visit their restaurant for some eggs, cold noodle soup, and shaved ice with red bean (trust me you'll love it!) As Korean spas go it is a pricier option, but we'll worth it given all of the options, if you're in the area you must try!
Deanna

I went to celebrate my birthday weekend and had a relaxing time. The staff was very helpful and give you a key fob for two separate lockers, one for your shoes and the other for your clothes/personal belongings. The nude pool in the locker rooms isn't my thing but it's available to those who are okay with that. The staff is constantly cleaning, which is a plus 👌🏾; keeps the facility nice and clean. The outdoor pools upstairs were nice and warm/hot. They have several different saunas and the food was good 😊. I didn't get to stay as long as I wanted since I had to leave by a certain time to fight the traffic. I would definitely return.
Megan Durst

I've gone with my small group multiple times and with my spouse and we all thoroughly enjoy it. I usually get the body scrub because who doesn't like their skin feeling like a baby's skin? And the ice bath has become one of my favorite parts, but I've always enjoyed the variety of saunas and bade pool, and the outdoor pool(and hot tub, and bridge) is beautiful & can be relaxing too(Just maybe not on a Saturday when it's busy😅). Definitely going back.
Mykyla J

This place was AMAZING, i stepped out of many comfort zones by going here. Things are a little confusing if you are getting the body scrub service, but there were other people there who helped even if the staff couldn't. Everybody was so friendly. I will continue to keep coming back. It's a 4 hour drive from where i stay, but it is worth the drive. I will also bring other people back along with me spreading the word of this amazing place !!!
Asel Dav

King Spa in Chantilly, VA, is a Korean-inspired spa offering a range of wellness and relaxation services. It features various saunas, including traditional Korean heated rooms, salt rooms, and cold rooms, designed to promote detoxification and relaxation. Additionally, King Spa offers body scrubs, massages, and other therapeutic treatments. The spa also includes amenities such as pools, relaxation lounges, and dining options, making it a comprehensive destination for a rejuvenating experience. This is my favorite place to relax… Highly recommend it, you will love this place ❤️

children.html:
What is Hinoki wood and why is it used for the bath?

Hinoki is a type of Japanese cypress known for its calming scent, antimicrobial properties, and resistance to moisture—making it ideal for spa environments.

Is the Hinoki Bath co-ed?

Yes, it is located near our outdoor bade pool and is co-ed and open for anyone’s enjoyment.

Does the Hinoki Bath have water jets?

Yes. It functions as a heated hot tub with soothing water jets for light muscle relief and improved circulation.

Can I use the Hinoki Bath after a body scrub or massage?

Absolutely. It’s a great way to relax muscles and unwind before or after a treatment.

Where is the Hinoki Bath located inside King Spa?

It’s on the second floor next to the outdoor bade pool.

What are the hours of the Hinoki Bath?

The Hinoki Bath and outdoor bade pool hours are Sunday–Thursday from 10 AM to 10 PM, and Friday–Saturday from 10 AM to 11 PM.
